key_insight: Test-time gradient updates encode episode observations into world model parameters, improving long-term memory beyond contextual memory alone.
engineering_relevance: Episode-specific world model adaptation could help reinforcement learning agents solve tasks requiring persistent memory and planning.
method: Update world model parameters with gradient descent at test time.
Encode observation history into a distinct world model for each episode.
Evaluate across memory-focused tasks and broader control benchmarks.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent gains across world model architectures on Memory Maze 2D, new state-of-the-art results on 3D Memory Maze, and strong performance on DeepMind Control and Atari 100k.
watch_item: Test-time optimization introduces additional computation; the abstract does not quantify its latency or resource costs.
paper_title: Encoding Memory in World Models with Test-Time Model-Based Reinforcement Learning
